# Pagination

Page switcher with range text ("61–80 von 243"), prev/next and numbered pages with ellipses.

`KenosUI.Pagination` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Pagination count={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Pagination" count="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
